title: Parametric Flanged Shaft Hub

title: Parametric Involute Spur Gear Generator
description: Metric module spur gear generator in OpenSCAD computing pitch diameter, addendum/dedendum radii, radially arrayed tooth profiles, and keyed shaft bore.

title: Finned Power-Electronics Heatsink Enclosure
description: Extruded aluminum power-inverter housing combining an internal PCB cavity, corner mounting bosses, and a parametric array of external cooling fins.
